name: Zhestokaja real'nost': Uzhasnyj son
source:
The story is about fears and the past that can sit inside us, in our subconscious, and resurface at the most unusual moments.
Fear, friendship, hallucinations that mingle with reality...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2416370/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述那些潜藏于内心、埋藏在潜意识中的恐惧与往事，它们可能在最意想不到的时刻重新浮现。
恐惧、友情，以及与现实交错的幻觉……

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2416370/]Steam[/url]]
